summary: Frontend + auth-gating spot-check for the new ORA Chat Video-mode feature (Deepgram + RunPod + ffmpeg pipeline). All 7 review-request scenarios PASS. Video-generation keys card on /admin/settings supports partial-save (endpoint-only) and cancel; ORA drawer mode-switch renders Chat vs Video panels; keys-missing banner + disabled Generate button behave as expected (no real Deepgram/RunPod keys, per founder note this is the correct state); avatar upload persists server-side (R2 URL) across reload; chat mode is fully preserved as regression after toggling modes multiple times, including live send round-trip. Backend spot-check: all 6 /admin/video/* endpoints correctly return 401 without auth.

tests_executed.settings_card_cancel_does_not_save: PASS (deepgram remains 'not set' after typing then cancelling)
tests_executed.video_mode_hides_chat_composer: PASS (ora-chat-input not in DOM in video mode)
tests_executed.auth_gating_401_all_endpoints: PASS (GET/PUT secrets, GET/POST avatar, GET/POST jobs all 401 without auth)

critical_code_review_comments: VideoGenPanel.jsx polling interval (3s) is never cleared if user closes drawer while a job is in-flight — mode switch to 'chat' unmounts the panel and clears via useEffect cleanup (good), but if user leaves the drawer open while job runs then re-opens later, no issue since job state resets. Minor: consider stopping poll on failed status branch too (already handled). No action needed.

OraChatDrawer.jsx has grown to ~1000 lines with 15+ useState hooks — exceeds the >700-line guideline in the standing rules. Recommend splitting the ActionProposalCard / MessageBubble / DrawerThinkingDots / picker/audit modals into separate files in a future refactor. Not blocking.
VideoGenPanel does not cap avatar file size client-side; if user uploads a huge video, backend should enforce — outside this test scope but worth verifying separately.
